shortDescription: Bangladesh is preparing its first foreign-currency sovereign bond sale and aims to raise between $500 million and $1 billion within the next three months, a senior government official said, according to Bloomberg.

title: Bangladesh Plans First Foreign-Currency Sovereign Bond Sale
